description: Add a guidance hint to a project. Use for domain knowledge not in the source text. Then call aethis_generate_and_test to regenerate.

adherence.description: How strictly the LLM must follow this hint. 'exact' = must follow precisely, produce nothing beyond what is specified; 'guided' = strong preference, may adapt if source text requires (default); 'loose' = soft suggestion.

guidance_text.description: Domain knowledge or correction not present in the source text

process_type.description: Which authoring phase this hint targets. Use 'field_extraction' for field design principles (e.g. raw-facts principle, solicitor navigation). Defaults to 'rule_generation'.

name: aethis_add_guidance
